mainEntity.name: Do I need to be experienced?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. All levels are welcome, from first-time camera owners to experienced photographers. Groups are small (usually max 6), so you get guidance pitched exactly at your level — we start wherever you are.

mainEntity.name: What camera and kit do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any camera you can use in manual or semi-manual mode is fine, including many bridge cameras. A tripod helps for landscapes; if you don't have one, Alan can lend you a tripod and filters on the day. A full kit list is sent with your joining instructions.
They range from short two-hour woodland walks to full days at the coast or in the hills. The length is shown on each workshop so you can pick what suits you.
Small — usually a maximum of six people, sometimes fewer, depending on the location and parking. That keeps plenty of one-to-one time available.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the weather's bad?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work with the conditions — some of the best landscape images come from dramatic weather. Workshops run in most conditions; if anything makes a location unsafe or unworkable, Alan will offer a new date or a credit.

Included: expert on-location tuition, a small group, image review and feedback, loan of filters and a tripod if needed, and joining instructions in advance. Not included: travel to and from the location, and lunch or refreshments — bring a packed lunch, or use a cafe or pub at the break on full days.

mainEntity.name: How will I know where to meet?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll get a joining email a few days before your workshop with the exact meeting point, parking information and final details, along with the recommended kit list — so you have time to plan your journey.

mainEntity.name: How do I book, and can I spread the cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book directly through the website or the workshop calendar. If you'd prefer to spread the cost, an interest-free 12-month payment plan is available. Workshops also make great gifts as digital gift vouchers.

If you need to cancel, please let Alan know in writing as early as you can; cancellation charges apply on a sliding scale depending on how close to the date it is. Full details are in the booking terms and conditions.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a workshop as a gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — digital gift vouchers are valid for 12 months and can be used against any workshop, course or one-to-one session.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring a friend or partner?

acceptedAnswer.text: If they'd like to take part and there's a place available, yes — just book a place for each of you, and call or message Alan first to check availability. Workshops are hands-on sessions built around each participant, so they're not set up for a non-photographing guest to come along and watch.
